latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Service-Based Architecture Designer.

- Guides design of coarse-grained service-based architectures (4–12 services), including domain service decomposition.
- Helps choose database partitioning strategy: shared, domain-partitioned, or per-service.
- Advises on API layer design and when to add it.
- Supports decisions between ACID and eventual consistency (BASE) transaction models.
- Recommends default approaches if certain information is missing, and prompts for key requirements as needed.
- Draws on material from "Fundamentals of Software Architecture" (Chapter 13).
